_README: Selectors that can be gutted to a constant without any test noticing.
DISCOVERED, NOT DESIGNED. These were found by scripts/selector-teeth.mjs on
the first 12 guards it audited (PR #894 touched 88). They are PRE-EXISTING
debt, not caused by the PR that surfaced them, and 12 of 12 files had at
least one — so the repo almost certainly has many more among its 506 guards.
· A survivor NOT listed here FAILS the build. New debt is blocked.
· A listed entry that no longer survives ALSO fails, with instructions to
delete it. The list cannot rot into a permanent allowlist the way an
· Adding an entry is a visible diff in a PR. That is the point: it should
cost a reviewer's attention, not be a silent escape hatch.
WHY A BASELINE AND NOT A FIX: each of these needs a non-empty control on the
population its guard actually scans, which is a judgement per guard, not a
sweep. Holding an unrelated PR hostage to that work would be the wrong trade;
leaving the tool non-blocking would be worse, because a check that cannot
fail is the defect this whole tool exists to find.
